sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of ferumoxytol during breastfeeding; however, the drug has been given safely to neonates intravenously as a magnetic resonance contrast agent. For additional information on iron use during breastfeeding, see the monograph on Iron Salts.
